name: Smooth Lines
source:
Mr One-Dimensional has only one hope to secure the ladies - cheesy pick up lines!  But will too many hurt his chances?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210616013149/https://godline.itch.io/smooth-lines]Itch.io[/url]]
